declared_cohort_exposure: The cohort and source table have been inspected in development; native checkpoints may include these training reactions. No independent risk reduction or advantage can be concluded.
supplied_spread_definition: Population SD of100released model reaction-member sums, normalized by absolute extent. Deterministic bridge uncertainty excluded.
ranking: Ascending feature score; rank_sum is equal-weight sum of doubled empirical midranks.
ties: Expected risk over all exact-k boundary-tier subsets. No use of labels to break ties.

bootstrap.reason: Complete, justified source/family clusters were not supplied.

scope: Finite supplied cohort. Generalization, total error calibration and source/experimental independence require separate evidence. Rankings are compared using the same retained counts; no new predictor is selected or fitted.
